about:
![Haste's Super Tweaks](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/hastecraft/super-tweaks/master/.github/banner.png)

Opinionated and highly optimized quality-of-life tweaks for WoW Forever in one neat package.

More than 50 tweaks, from a campfire timer and an XP tracker to better tooltips and automatic junk selling, each one switched on and set up in a single settings window. It also loads on Classic Era.

Type `/hst` in game to open the settings. Each tweak can be turned on or off at any time without a `/reload`. Tweaks that act for you or replace part of the game's interface start off. The full list of tweaks and how each behaves is in [HastesSuperTweaks/README.md](https://github.com/hastecraft/super-tweaks/blob/master/HastesSuperTweaks/README.md).

## Highlights

### Campfire Helper

![Campfire Helper](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/hastecraft/super-tweaks/master/.github/highlights/campfire-helper.gif)

On WoW Forever, a campfire on screen shows when you're near a fire, counts down while you sit by it, then shows how long your camp buffs have left and blinks when they're about to run out. Show it as a ring, a bar or an icon. `/hst camp check` lists every camp timer.

### XP Tracker

![XP Tracker](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/hastecraft/super-tweaks/master/.github/highlights/xp-tracker.png)

An XP bar with rested XP, XP from completed quests, XP per hour and time to level. Mob tooltips say roughly how many more kills of that mob you need to level, and the quest log shows each quest's XP.

### Better Tooltips

![Better Tooltips](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/hastecraft/super-tweaks/master/.github/highlights/better-tooltips.png)

A health bar under unit tooltips (in class colors, or green to red by health), borders in class colors, guild ranks and notes, and who the unit is targeting. On WoW Forever, your Recent Allies show where and when you last played together. Item tooltips can say how many you have in your bags and banks, and item, spell and NPC IDs are optional. Works with tooltip styles from other addons.

### Appearance Collector

![Appearance Collector](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/hastecraft/super-tweaks/master/.github/highlights/appearance-collector.png)

On WoW Forever, a mark on gear whose look you haven't collected, in your bags, at vendors and in the Loot Window, and a line in item tooltips. Choose a hanger, shirt, sparkle or dot. Sell Clutter keeps that gear.

### Consumable Macros

![Consumable Macros](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/hastecraft/super-tweaks/master/.github/highlights/consumable-macros.png)

Macros that always use your best food, drink, bandage and potions as your bags change, plus one that eats and drinks at once, a hunter's Feed Pet, and ones that put your best stone, oil or poison on each weapon. Drag them onto your action bars from the Macros window.

### Loot Window and Fast Loot

![Loot Window](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/hastecraft/super-tweaks/master/.github/highlights/loot-window.png)

A compact loot list with a Take All button and hotkey. While you auto loot, it lists what you picked up for a few seconds. Fast Loot takes everything at once and still lets gathering trackers see the loot.

### Sell Junk and Sell Clutter

![Sell Junk and Sell Clutter](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/hastecraft/super-tweaks/master/.github/highlights/sell-junk-and-clutter.png)

Greys are sold at any vendor. Sell Clutter also sells the items you collect while leveling and won't use:

- cooking ingredients and monster parts that none of your professions use
- other classes' reagents
- gear your class can't use
- food, potions and white gear you've outleveled

It keeps quest items, items your RestedXP guide needs, equipment sets, profession tools, expensive materials, anything that opens and gear whose look you haven't collected. Item tooltips say what will be sold, and `/hst clutter list` shows the full list before you reach a vendor.

### Better Scrolling Combat Text

![Better Scrolling Combat Text](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/hastecraft/super-tweaks/master/.github/highlights/better-scrolling-combat-text.gif)

Separate scroll areas for damage and healing you take and for notices: entering and leaving combat, low health and mana, combo points, auras, reputation, honor and skill-ups. Damage numbers can show on enemy nameplates. Choose fonts, colors, animations and filters, and move each area in Edit Mode.

## Settings window

![Settings window](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/hastecraft/super-tweaks/master/.github/highlights/settings-window.png)

- Point at a tweak in the list to see its description, a preview and its main settings beside it.
- Search finds any tweak or setting by name, description or menu choice. Switches work in the results, and Enter jumps to the setting.
- Tweaks you can see on screen, like the XP bar, tooltips, the loot window and combat text, have a live preview beside their settings that redraws as you change them.
- The cog in the title bar picks the window's theme: Graphite, Ember or Moonwell.
- Profiles hold every tweak's settings. Switch, copy and reset them, or share one as text.

## All tweaks

**Leveling:** XP Tracker, Rep Tracker (the XP bar for a reputation; right-click it to pick the faction), Kills to Level, Quest XP in Quest Log, Screenshot Level-Ups, Zone Levels on World Map (each zone's level range as you hover it), Upgrade Spell Ranks (new spells and ranks go on your bars), Train All, Campfire Helper (a campfire on screen that counts down sitting and your camp buffs).

**Quests:** Auto Accept & Turn In Quests, Skip NPC Chat, Quest Item Sparkle, Quest Item Button (one button and key for your current quest's item), Quest Reward Value (marks the reward that sells for the most), Hide Quest Tracker (in dungeons, PvP, combat or always), Quest Marks & Rare Alerts (quest marks on nameplates, and a rare alert).

**Combat:** Better Scrolling Combat Text, Swing Timer Style (your colors for the game's swing timer, and bars that hide while idle), Aura Reminders (your own text when a buff is missing or running out, or a proc is up), Combo Points on Nameplates (rogues and druids), Druid Mana in Forms (your mana under the player frame in cat and bear form), Overpower Alert (Overpower when a mob dodges you, in any stance), Consumable Macros (always your best food, drink, bandage and potion, plus Feed Pet and weapon stones, oils and poisons).

**Gear and bags:** Gear Upgrades (how much better an item is for your talents, with stat weights for every spec and hit caps counted from your own stats), Gear Shift (a bar to swap gear and gear sets, trinket queues, and gear that goes on when you mount, swim or rest), Appearance Collector (marks gear whose look you haven't collected), Auto-Equip Bags, Bag Tweaks, Bag Cleaner.

**Loot and vendors:** Loot Window, Movable Loot Rolls, Fast Loot, Sell Junk, Sell Clutter, Repair Automatically (guild funds optional), Restock at Vendors (ammo, reagents and poisons, and the vendor reagents your tracked recipes need, up to a gold limit per visit), Super Auction House (shopping lists and the materials for any recipe or enchant, bought with one key, undercutting, posting rules and price formulas, a sniper, a crafting queue, a disenchant helper, price charts, a watchlist, sold alerts, tooltip prices, counts of what your other characters have and a history of your gold, all stored on your computer).

**Dungeons and PvP:** Group Finder (a Looking For Group window that shows every member's class, level and role, filters by the role a group needs, lists you in one click and sorts /who), Instance Tracker (a history of your dungeon and raid runs with their XP, gold, kills, loot and group, and your instances entered against the hourly and daily limits), Dungeon Timer (times your dungeon and raid runs, boss by boss, against your best), Battleground Alerts (a countdown to enter, a gates alert and the match result in chat), Auto Release in Battlegrounds, Faction Tracker (how many Alliance and Horde players you come across in each zone).

**Accept and decline:** Auto Accept Summons, Auto Accept Resurrection, and auto-decline for Battle.net friend requests, duels, guild charters, join requests, party invites and shared quests. Friends, guildmates and community members can be let through.

**Chat, guild and mail:** Right-Click Guild Invite, Guild Message Popup, Chat Spam Filter (hides gold selling, boosting, recruitment and guilds you mute in public channels), Auto-Invite Customers (invites and whispers players asking in trade chat for a portal, an enchant or a craft you offer), Hide Warlock Pet Chatter (what warlock demons say, in chat and over their heads), Mail Expiry & Alt List, Mail Gold Guard (marks gold mailed by strangers so Open All skips it).

**Interface:** Better Tooltips, Better Breath Meter, Better World Refresh (a countdown bar for WoW Forever's world refresh, with alerts and an automatic refresh at a safe moment), Error Message Filter, Game Settings (camera distance, nameplate range, spell queue window, threat percentage, outlines, map fade and other settings the game's options don't show, reapplied at login, plus Edit Mode layout backups), Minimap Button, Hide Issue Reporter.

**Sound:** Mute Mount Sounds, Mute Custom Sounds (rain, spell fizzle, or any sound file ID), Aura Sounds (a sound when the buffs or debuffs you choose appear or fade, in combat too), Quest Progress Sounds (when an objective or a whole quest is done).

## Install

1. Download the ZIP from the latest release.
2. Unzip it into your game's `Interface\AddOns` folder, so that you get `Interface\AddOns\HastesSuperTweaks`.
3. Restart the game.

What changed in each version is in [CHANGELOG.md](https://github.com/hastecraft/super-tweaks/blob/master/CHANGELOG.md), and in game: click the version beside the settings window's title.

## Contributing

Bug reports, ideas and pull requests are welcome: see [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/hastecraft/super-tweaks/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md). The addon is the `HastesSuperTweaks` folder. The scripts in `tools` need Python 3 (`python -m pip install -r tools/requirements.txt`):

- `python tools/install.py` installs the addon into the game. Set `HST_WOW_DIR` to your game folder (the one holding `Interface`). `--dry-run` shows what it would do.
- `python tools/bench.py` counts the work done on the addon's hot paths in a mocked game runtime (`tools/mockgame`). CI compares it on every pull request.
- `python tools/check.py` runs the consistency checks CI runs.
- `python tools/verify.py` runs what CI runs on a pull request: luacheck (when it's installed), the consistency checks and the bench compared with `origin/master`.
- `python tools/make_art.py` redraws the icons in `HastesSuperTweaks/Art`.

The name and logo are not covered by it: see [TRADEMARKS.md](https://github.com/hastecraft/super-tweaks/blob/master/TRADEMARKS.md). The embedded libraries keep their own licenses, listed in [HastesSuperTweaks/Libs/THIRD-PARTY-LICENSES.txt](https://github.com/hastecraft/super-tweaks/blob/master/HastesSuperTweaks/Libs/THIRD-PARTY-LICENSES.txt).

releases.notes:
### Zone Levels on World Map

Hovering a zone on the world map shows its level range beside its name, colored for your level. It starts off.

### Changes

- Gear Upgrades: rings and trinkets show how they compare with each one you wear.
- Legacy Tracker, Bank Helper and Loot Roll Tracker are removed.

### Bug Fixes

- Gear Upgrades: items that list healing and spell damage on one line count both.
- Instance Tracker: the tiles along the top of the window no longer overlap the first time it opens.

### Overpower Alert

Shows the Overpower icon and plays a sound when a mob dodges you, in any stance, on screen, on the mob's nameplate or only in the combat text. Choose its glow, border and sound. For warriors. It starts off.

### Changes

- Better Scrolling Combat Text: "Overpower!" shows when a mob dodges you in any stance, not only in Battle Stance.

### Changes

- Dungeon Timer: killed bosses are greyed out.

### Bug Fixes

- Instance Tracker: coming back into an instance alive continues the run on WoW Forever, unless it was reset.
- Dungeon Timer: coming back into an instance continues the run, unless it was reset.
- Dungeon Timer: "Align the name and clock" now moves the instance name too.

### Changes

- Dungeon Timer: new "Width", "Height" and "Align the name and clock" settings. With a height, bosses already killed make room first.
- Dungeon Timer: click a boss's name to target it.

### Rep Tracker

A reputation bar for the faction you track, with what you've gained this session and the time to your next standing. Move it in Edit Mode. It starts off.

### Dungeon Timer

Times your dungeon and raid runs boss by boss against your best, with your deaths, the gold you looted and what your loot is worth. It starts off.

### Super Auction House: Posting Rules

Groups and single items can have posting rules: a minimum, normal and maximum price, what to do below your minimum, duration, starting bid, and how many to keep on sale and in your bags. Prices can be formulas, such as "usual * 80%".

### Super Auction House: Sniper and Crafting Queue

A Sniper view in Shopping keeps searching for auctions at or under your prices. Crafting has its own tab, with a queue of recipes to keep in stock and a key to craft the next one.

### New Features

- Super Auction House: Disenchant. Lists gear worth more as materials, and disenchants it one click at a time.
- Super Auction House: Other Characters. Tooltips can show how many your other characters have, and shopping lists can count their items as yours.
- Super Auction House: Priced Low. The Auctions tab marks auctions priced low, and Cancel Next takes them so you can post them for more.
- Super Auction House: Mail and Vendor Rules. A group's rules can mail it to a character through Mail Expiry & Alt List, or sell it to vendors.

### Changes

- Super Auction House: dropdowns are easier to see, buttons show their keys, and the Shopping side panel's view is picked from a dropdown.
- Super Auction House: list alerts and the Sniper count searches by part of a name, and ones priced with a formula.
- Group Finder: picking an activity the last search didn't cover searches for it.
- Better Scrolling Combat Text: "Off" for enemy damage also hides the game's own damage numbers.
- Settings that do nothing while their parent setting is off are greyed out, section names match across tweaks, and sound buttons all say "Play sample".
- Previews no longer have captions under them, and tweak summaries are shorter.
- Quest Item Button, Chat Spam Filter, Gear Upgrades, XP Tracker, Instance Tracker and Mail Expiry & Alt List do less work.

### Bug Fixes

- Super Auction House: "Price for the whole stack" and prices on vendor and auction listing tooltips now work.
- Super Auction House: small windows no longer cut off or overlap the Selling tab's buttons, the cards or the Auctions table.
- Super Auction House: taking auction mail stops with a message when the game won't hand a letter over.
- Group Finder: groups whose leader's name arrives late are listed again.
- Instance Tracker: counts a kill when the game hides the XP message, and keeps the run when the game can't report the instance for a moment.
- Gear Upgrades counts lines like "+10 Fire Resistance" and "+20 Fire Spell Damage".
- Aura Reminders no longer shows reminders while it's off.
- Gear Shift: an item swapped out from the menu can be picked again, a swap waiting for the fight to end isn't lost while you hold an item, situations work with the bar hidden, and profile strings keep every slot.
- Importing a profile string can no longer break the Loot Window's background color.
- Auto-Invite Customers no longer invites someone who's already in your group.
- Restock at Vendors no longer repeats the low ammo warning while you drag "Warn below (ammo left)".
- Better Breath Meter shows a timer that was already running at its real value after a loading screen.
- Appearance Collector no longer keeps asking for an item the game can't load.
- Minimap Button: the settings preview follows the button when you drag it.
- Instance Tracker's "Clear history" confirmation reads correctly.
- Settings search says "1 more setting matches" when there's one.
